info.name: CareerPlatform API
info.description: Auto-generated. Set `baseUrl` and `token` under the collection variables tab.

request.description: Maps POST /api/Auth/login. Anonymous + sensitive rate limit for brute-force resilience.
Maps POST /api/Auth/password/forgot. Anonymous + sensitive rate limit so bots cannot enumerate emails at speed. Response shape is identical for known and unknown emails (anti-enumeration).
Maps POST /api/Auth/password/reset. Anonymous + sensitive rate limit so the endpoint remains resistant to brute-force despite the fixed generic failure message.
Maps POST /api/Auth/register/resend. Anonymous + sensitive rate limit.
Maps POST /api/Auth/register/start. Anonymous (registration is by definition pre-auth) but carries the sensitive rate limit so bot-driven signup floods are throttled per IP.
Maps POST /api/Auth/register/verify. Anonymous + sensitive rate limit.
Maps GET /api/Dashboard/admin/broadcasts?type=. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit. Thin.
Maps POST /api/Dashboard/admin/broadcasts. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit. The route path is preserved verbatim from the frontend contract (broadcastService.sendBroadcast).
Maps GET /api/Dashboard/admin/broadcasts/recipients?plan=. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit. Returns a single .
Two routes share this handler: GET /api/Certificates/{id}/download — student, must own the row. GET /api/Admin/Certificates/{id}/download — admin, any row.
Two routes share this handler: GET /api/Certificates/{id}/download — student, must own the row. GET /api/Admin/Certificates/{id}/download — admin, any row.
Maps POST /api/Admin/ContentManagement/import/interview. Accepts a single multipart/form-data file field named file containing an .xlsx workbook. Admin-only + sensitive rate limiting.

Maps GET /api/ContentManagement/languages (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: dispatch → translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Admin-only (Req 20.5) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 21).

Maps POST /api/ContentManagement/languages (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind the request body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Declares Admin-only authorization inline (Req 20.5) and preserves the legacy sensitive rate-limiting policy (Req 21).

Maps PUT /api/ContentManagement/languages/{id:int}/price (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind route id + body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Admin-only (Req 20.5) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 21).

Maps PUT /api/ContentManagement/languages/{id:int}/publish (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind route id + body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Admin-only (Req 20.5) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 21).

Maps PUT /api/ContentManagement/languages/{languageId:int}/sections/reorder (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind route id + body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Admin-only (Req 20.5) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 21).

Maps GET /api/ContentManagement/public/curriculum/{langSlug} (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: dispatch → translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). This is the one public read: it declares explicitly (Req 20.5, 20.6) and intentionally does NOT call RequireRateLimiting, reproducing the legacy [AllowAnonymous] + [DisableRateLimiting] decision (Req 21).

Maps POST /api/ContentManagement/sections (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind the request body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Admin-only (Req 20.5) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 21).

Maps PUT /api/ContentManagement/sections/{sectionId:int}/topics/reorder (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind route id + body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Admin-only (Req 20.5) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 21).
Maps POST /api/ContentManagement/topics. Admin-only + sensitive rate limiting.

Maps DELETE /api/ContentManagement/topics/{id:int} (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: dispatch, then map success to 204 No Content (the legacy status) and any failure via the shared translator (Req 4.2, 4.3). Admin-only (Req 20.5) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 21).

Maps GET /api/ContentManagement/topics/{id:int} (route preserved verbatim from the legacy ContentManagementController, Req 24.2). Thin: dispatch → translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Admin-only (Req 20.5) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 21).
Maps PUT /api/ContentManagement/topics/{id:int}. Admin-only + sensitive rate limiting.
Maps GET /api/Courses. Thin: bind optional page/pageSize query params, dispatch, translate. Admin-only + sensitive rate limiting. The public catalog is served by at /api/Courses/catalog.
Maps POST /api/Courses. Thin: bind the request body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 14.2). Admin-only (Req 14.3) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 14.6).

Maps GET /api/Courses/catalog. Anonymous — pricing pages must render on public marketing routes without a JWT (same waiver as the plan catalog). Course purchase itself remains authenticated in the Orders slice.
Maps DELETE /api/Courses/{id:int}. Thin: dispatch, then map success to 204 No Content and any failure via the shared translator. Admin-only + sensitive rate limiting.
Maps GET /api/Courses/{id:int}. Thin: dispatch → translate. Admin-only + sensitive rate limiting. Public catalog browsing goes through GET /api/Courses/catalog instead.
Maps PUT /api/Courses/{id:int}. Thin: bind the route id + body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 14.2). Admin-only (Req 14.3) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 14.6).

Maps GET /api/Dashboard/admin/stats (route preserved verbatim from the legacy DashboardController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind → dispatch → translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Declares its own authorization decision inline — Admin only (Req 20.5) — and preserves the legacy sensitive rate-limiting policy (Req 21). The optional filter query parameter defaults to "month" to match the legacy controller signature.

Maps GET /api/Dashboard/admin/student-performance (route preserved verbatim from the legacy DashboardController, Req 24.2). Thin: dispatch → translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Declares its own authorization decision inline — Admin only (Req 20.5) — and preserves the legacy sensitive rate-limiting policy (Req 21).

Maps GET /api/Dashboard/admin/students (route preserved verbatim from the legacy DashboardController, Req 24.2). Thin: dispatch → translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Declares its own authorization decision inline — Admin only (Req 20.5) — and preserves the legacy sensitive rate-limiting policy (Req 21). The legacy endpoint returned a bare list with no pagination, so the payload contract is preserved as a list (Req 24.2).
GET /api/LearningPaths — public, published only. GET /api/Admin/LearningPaths — admin, all rows.
GET /api/LearningPaths — public, published only. GET /api/Admin/LearningPaths — admin, all rows.
Maps DELETE /api/Dashboard/admin/meetings?id=. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit. The id comes from the query string (matches the existing frontend contract).
Maps GET /api/Dashboard/admin/meetings. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps POST /api/Dashboard/admin/meetings. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit. Route path preserved verbatim from the frontend meetingService.scheduleMeeting.
Maps PUT /api/Dashboard/admin/meetings. Meeting id lives in the body (matches the existing frontend contract: { id, ...patch }).

Maps two GET routes onto the same query: GET /api/Mentorship/mentors — authenticated catalog (active + verified only) GET /api/Dashboard/admin/mentors — admin management (every mentor) Both authenticated; admin route additionally requires the Admin role.
Maps POST /api/Dashboard/admin/mentors. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps PUT /api/Dashboard/admin/mentors. Mentor id lives in the body (matches existing frontend contract). Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps GET /api/Mentorship/admin/bookings. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps POST /api/Mentorship/admin/bookings/{id}/cancel. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps POST /api/Mentorship/admin/slots. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps DELETE /api/Mentorship/admin/slots/{id}. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps POST /api/Mentorship/book. Authenticated + sensitive rate limit.

Maps two GET routes onto the same query: GET /api/Mentorship/mentors — authenticated catalog (active + verified only) GET /api/Dashboard/admin/mentors — admin management (every mentor) Both authenticated; admin route additionally requires the Admin role.
Maps GET /api/Mentorship/mentors/{mentorId}/slots. Any authenticated caller.
Maps GET /api/Mentorship/my-bookings. Any authenticated caller.

Maps POST /api/Admin/PublishNotification. Thin: bind body → dispatch → translate. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit. The route path is preserved verbatim from the frontend contract (`endpoints.notifications.publish`).
Maps POST /api/Notifications/clear-all. Authenticated + sensitive rate limit.

Maps GET /api/Notifications/me. Thin: dispatch → translate (Req 14.2). Requires an authenticated caller; identity comes from the JWT, never the request (Req 14.4). No sensitive rate limit — the notification bell polls this on every page render.
Maps POST /api/Notifications/read-all. Authenticated + sensitive rate limit.
Maps POST /api/Notifications/{id:int}/read. Thin: dispatch, map success to 204 No Content (Req 14.2). Authenticated + sensitive rate limit (state-changing write).

Maps GET /api/AdminOffer/pending (route preserved verbatim from the legacy AdminOfferController, Req 24.2). Thin: dispatch → translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Declares its own authorization decision inline — Admin only (Req 20.5) — and preserves the legacy sensitive rate-limiting policy (Req 21).

Maps POST /api/AdminOffer/{id:int}/verify (route preserved verbatim from the legacy AdminOfferController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind the request body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Declares Admin-only authorization inline (Req 20.5) and preserves the legacy sensitive rate-limiting policy (Req 21). An invalid status is rejected by as a 400 ProblemDetails; an unknown id yields a 404.

Maps POST /api/Payment/create-order (route preserved verbatim from the legacy PaymentController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind the command from the body, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Requires an authenticated caller — NOT Admin: any signed-in student may create an order (Req 20.5) — and preserves the legacy sensitive rate-limiting policy (Req 21). The user id is derived from the JWT inside the handler, never from the body.

Maps POST /api/Payment/verify (route preserved verbatim from the legacy PaymentController, Req 24.2). Thin: bind the command from the body, dispatch, translate (Req 4.2, 4.3). Requires an authenticated caller — NOT Admin: any signed-in student verifies their own payment (Req 20.5) — and preserves the legacy sensitive rate-limiting policy (Req 21). The user id is derived from the JWT inside the handler, never from the body.
GET /api/PlacementCompanies — published catalog, anonymous. GET /api/Admin/PlacementCompanies — admin management, all rows.
GET /api/PlacementCompanies — published catalog, anonymous. GET /api/Admin/PlacementCompanies — admin management, all rows.
Two GET routes onto one query — student catalog and admin management: GET /api/Practice — published only, anonymous GET /api/Admin/Practice — every row, Admin only
Maps POST /api/Admin/Practice. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps DELETE /api/Admin/Practice/{id:int}. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Maps PUT /api/Admin/Practice/{id:int}. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit.
Two GET routes onto one query — student catalog and admin management: GET /api/Practice — published only, anonymous GET /api/Admin/Practice — every row, Admin only

Two routes hit this handler: POST /api/Practice/bookmarks/{questionId} — sets On=true, optional notes body. DELETE /api/Practice/bookmarks/{questionId} — sets On=false. Both are idempotent so the frontend can fire-and-forget without checking prior state.

Two routes hit this handler: POST /api/Practice/bookmarks/{questionId} — sets On=true, optional notes body. DELETE /api/Practice/bookmarks/{questionId} — sets On=false. Both are idempotent so the frontend can fire-and-forget without checking prior state.
Maps GET /api/Practice/{slug}. Anonymous — public detail page.

Two routes share this handler: - GET /api/Admin/StudentResumes/{id}/download — Admin, any resume. - GET /api/Mentor/StudentResumes/{id}/download — Mentor, only if assigned. The handler receives an allowAdmin flag from the route so it can short-circuit the ownership check for admins without duplicating the streaming logic.

Two routes share this handler: - GET /api/Admin/StudentResumes/{id}/download — Admin, any resume. - GET /api/Mentor/StudentResumes/{id}/download — Mentor, only if assigned. The handler receives an allowAdmin flag from the route so it can short-circuit the ownership check for admins without duplicating the streaming logic.
Maps POST /api/Resumes/me/upload-pdf. Multipart file field must be a application/pdf ≤ 1 MB. Authenticated (any student) + sensitive rate limit.
Maps GET /api/Admin/Settings with an optional ?category= filter. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit. Thin: bind → dispatch → translate (Req 14.2).
Maps PUT /api/Admin/Settings. Admin-only + sensitive rate limit. Thin: bind body → map to command → dispatch → translate (Req 14.2).
Maps GET /api/SubscriptionPlans. Thin: bind optional page/pageSize query params, dispatch, translate (Req 14.2). Admin-only (Req 14.3) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 14.6).
Maps POST /api/SubscriptionPlans. Thin: bind the request body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 14.2). Admin-only (Req 2.6, 14.3) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 14.6).

Maps GET /api/SubscriptionPlans/catalog. Thin: dispatch the parameterless query and translate (Req 14.2). Requires an authenticated caller — NOT Admin: any signed-in student may browse the active catalog (Req 6.4). This is a simple read, so it carries no Sensitive rate limit (only the checkout/verify payment slices do, Req 14.6).

Maps GET /api/SubscriptionPlans/entitlement. Thin: dispatch the parameterless query and translate (Req 14.2). Requires an authenticated caller — any signed-in student may read their own effective plan; the identity comes from the JWT, never the request (Req 12, 14.4). This is a simple read, so it carries no Sensitive rate limit.

Maps DELETE /api/SubscriptionPlans/{id:int}. Thin: dispatch, then map success to 204 No Content and any failure via the shared translator (Req 14.2). Admin-only (Req 5.4, 14.3) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 14.6).
Maps GET /api/SubscriptionPlans/{id:int}. Thin: dispatch → translate (Req 14.2). Admin-only (Req 14.3) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 14.6).
Maps PUT /api/SubscriptionPlans/{id:int}. Thin: bind the route id + body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 14.2). Admin-only (Req 3.7, 14.3) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 14.6).
Maps PUT /api/SubscriptionPlans/{id:int}/active. Thin: bind the route id + body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 14.2). Admin-only (Req 4.5, 14.3) + sensitive rate limiting (Req 14.6).

Maps POST /api/Auth/sync. Thin: bind the request body, dispatch, translate (Req 14.2). Requires an authenticated caller — the JWT subject is the source of truth for identity (Req 14.4). Called by the frontend right after Supabase sign-in / sign-up to guarantee the application database has a matching UserProfile row. Sensitive rate limit because it writes.

Maps GET /api/me. Thin: dispatch the parameterless query and translate (Req 14.2). Requires an authenticated caller — any signed-in user may read their own profile; the identity comes from the JWT, never the request (Req 14.4). A simple read, so no sensitive rate limit.

Maps PUT /api/me. Thin: bind the request body, map to the command, dispatch, translate (Req 14.2). Requires an authenticated caller — any signed-in user may update their own profile; the identity comes from the JWT, never the request (Req 14.4). Carries the sensitive rate limit as a state-changing self-service write (Req 14.6).

Maps POST /api/me/password. Authenticated + sensitive rate limit (state-changing write, resistance to brute-force against the current-password field). Applies to every signed-in role — the settings page uses the same call for students, mentors, and admins.
